property_summary: C.transfer should always return true for any valid input that doesn't revert.
C.transfer always returns a value equal to the negation of (false).
Any successful call to transfer returns the same boolean value as the input array length being greater than zero.
After any call to c.transfer that does not revert, calling the same function again with the same arguments must also not revert.
For any input arrays, transfer must always return true.
After calling transfer, the return value is always true when the call does not revert.
After calling transfer, the return value is always true.
